title: Vail Mountain: 3 in likely by 5 am (1.2 to 6.3)
lines: Mid-Vail / Mountaintop: 3 in likely in the 24 hours to 5 am, range 1.2 to 6.3.
Tonight, 5 pm to 5 am: 1.8 in likely (0 to 5). Since 5 am the gauge has measured 0.06 in of water, about 1.2 in of snow.
Tomorrow, 5 am to 5 am: 3.9 in likely (0.2 to 9.3).
Ridge gusts near 51 mph tomorrow. Wind hold likely on Orient Express Lift, possible on Skyline Express Lift, possible on Sun Up Express Lift, possible on Earl's Express Lift.
Big days are under-called by the likely number: read the high end.
